intro.answer: I build websites and applications and take care of everything needed to launch them - domains, hosting, configuration and technical support. You focus on your business while I take care of the technology.

about.sub: Who I am and how I work
about.title: Bio
about.p1: Hi! I’m Tomasz Skorupski. For years, I ensured that IT systems ran smoothly by managing servers (Windows/Linux), networks, and databases. However, I realized that I wanted to do more than just fix and maintain things-I wanted to create them. Today, I use my solid technical background to build and improve digital solutions.
about.videoInvite: If you prefer listening over reading - feel free to watch my short video introduction
about.approachIntro: I’m not just a developer, nor just an administrator. I am a versatile specialist who sees the bigger picture. My hybrid expertise ensures that the solutions I design are not only innovative but also infrastructurally robust.

points.design: Design & Improve: I write code and build applications while taking care of their architecture, testing, and optimization to eliminate defects.
points.deploy: Deploy: I use Git and Docker and develop core CI/CD skills so that my workflows are repeatable and safe.
points.support: Support & Understand: Thanks to experience in IT Support and Administration, I understand the user perspective and operational challenges. I know how crucial stability and security are in day-to-day work.

about.growth: In parallel, I’m developing my competencies by delivering my own projects. While professionally I focus on your needs, privately I’m passionate about the development and practical use of AI agents in automation - which always translates into a better understanding of modern architectures.
about.goal: I’m not just looking for "another gig". Above all, I’m seeking long-term collaboration with a Partner or Employer with whom I can build a relationship for years - a place where I can bring real value from day one and grow through ambitious projects. That said, I’m open to freelance work too, especially if it can be a stepping stone to something more.

services.sub: What I can do for you
services.title: IT Services
services.intro: I build websites and web applications and provide IT support for individuals and small businesses. I combine the roles of developer and systems administrator - so you get a solution that not only looks great, but is also stable, secure, and ready to go. To quickly get an estimated cost, complete the short quote form. I work remotely (from the Szczecin/Stargard area), with direct, straightforward communication - no middlemen, no agency markups.

card1.title: Website creation for businesses and individuals
card1.desc: I design and build modern websites: business cards, company sites, landing pages, and portfolios. Each one is responsive, fast, and optimised for basic SEO so your clients can find you on Google. I can build on a custom CMS or WordPress - with a panel where you can update content yourself, no coding required.
card1.forWhom: small businesses, freelancers, local companies, individuals.

card2.title: Custom web applications and process automation
card2.desc: I build applications tailored to specific needs: admin panels, simple CRM systems, management tools, and apps that automate repetitive tasks. I can also integrate with external services via API - e.g. payments, e-invoicing (KSeF), or AI tools. If you're running your business in Excel spreadsheets, I can turn that into a proper application.
card2.forWhom: businesses looking to streamline and automate their work.

card3.title: Programming help, fixes, and extensions
card3.desc: I also handle smaller programming jobs - no need to commission a full project. I'll fix and extend an existing site or app, squash bugs, write a script to automate tedious repetitive tasks, or help finish a project that got stuck. A great option when you need specific, fast technical help.
card3.forWhom: individuals and businesses with ongoing, smaller programming needs.

card4.title: IT support and outsourcing for small businesses
card4.desc: I'll handle the technical side of your business so you can focus on running it. I offer server administration (Windows and Linux), network and device configuration, backups, deployments, and user support. In practice, I act as an external IT department for a small company - available remotely, without the cost of hiring a full-time IT person.
card4.forWhom: small businesses without their own IT department.

shelltyLingo.title: Shellty Lingo
shelltyLingo.subtitle: - Mobile Language Learning Platform -
shelltyLingo.description: A mobile language-learning app being built from the ground up for intentional, lasting progress. It combines focused lessons, intelligent review and AI conversations to guide learners from their first words to more confident communication in English or Thai.
shelltyLingo.highlightsTitle: WHAT MAKES THIS PROJECT STAND OUT:
highlights: 📚 Course-based learning: separate progress, level, error history and learning plan for every language a learner chooses.
🔁 Spaced repetition: an intelligent review system and personal difficult-word list that reinforce knowledge at the right time.
🤖 Quality-controlled AI conversations: level-aware scenarios and correction modes, with limits and moderation enforced through the API.
🇹🇭 English and Thai: courses enhanced by a contextual dictionary, TTS, transliteration, and guidance on tones and cultural context.
🛠️ Product ecosystem: an Expo app, NestJS API and Next.js administration panel for managing versioned educational content.

shelltyCMS.title: Shellty CMS
shelltyCMS.subtitle: - WordPress Alternative for B2B -
shelltyCMS.description: Next.js and Payload CMS as a lightweight alternative to WordPress. Full control over code and content without unnecessary baggage.
highlights: 🔄 Clone & Deploy: 12 ready-made collections, replace content in CMS instead of writing code from scratch
🌍 i18n PL/EN: Payload localization, [locale] routing and URL helpers out of the box
🖼️ Cloudinary Plugin: Automatic upload and auto-delete of media on free tier
🔒 Security: Upstash rate limit, SHA-256 IP hashing, CSRF and honeypot
🤖 AI Lead Agent (WIP): Chat widget based on Gemini 2.5 Flash and Vercel AI SDK

shelltyPromptCoach.title: Prompt Coach
shelltyPromptCoach.subtitle: - AI Prompt Engineering Coach -
shelltyPromptCoach.description: An educational tool for prompt engineering that doesn't just give advice - it generates complete, ready-to-use prompts from the user's goal. Every prompt is grounded in a knowledge base (RAG) with cited sources and scored against measurable quality criteria; an existing prompt can also be analyzed or transformed using one of five modes (light, professional, agent, coding, research).
shelltyPromptCoach.highlightsTitle: WHAT MAKES THIS PROJECT STAND OUT:
highlights: 🧠 Prompt generator: Builds a complete prompt from scratch based on the user's goal - streamed in real time, with quality scoring and cited knowledge sources
🔍 Prompt analysis: Scans an existing prompt, flags strengths/weaknesses/gaps, and produces a targeted, improved version
✨ Improve mode: Transforms a draft prompt using one of 5 modes - light, professional, agent, coding, research
🔎 Hybrid knowledge base (RAG): Semantic search (embeddings) combined with full-text search via Reciprocal Rank Fusion, filtered by source reliability
🌍 PL/EN: Bilingual interface

shelltyPulse.title: Shellty Pulse - Service Health Monitor & Keep-Alive
shelltyPulse.subtitle: Service Health Monitor & Keep-Alive.
shelltyPulse.description: A professional-grade Service Health Monitor designed for real-time tracking of web service availability. It acts as an intelligent "keep-alive" mechanism for applications on free-tier platforms (e.g., Render), preventing idle sleep through automated, configurable pings.
highlights: Infrastructure as code & containerization: combining Docker Compose with Ansible for fully automated provisioning and consistent, repeatable server-side deployments.
End-to-end CI/CD automation: a robust GitHub Actions pipeline covering image builds, API endpoint testing, and automated deployment to ensure code reliability with every push.

postlio.title: Postlio (in development)
postlio.subtitle: - AI Social Media Autopilot -
postlio.description: A modern PWA application for comprehensive Social Media management with AI support. Enables creating, scheduling, and fully autonomous publishing of content on Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn.
highlights: 🤖 Autopilot Mode: Autonomous post generation and queuing system based on the brand's unique "Voice DNA", running in the background via APScheduler
🎨 AI Creator: Hybrid text (Gemini/Groq), image (Flux/SDXL), and video engine with an intelligent automatic provider switching mechanism (fallback)
🔒 Data Protection: Secure storage of OAuth tokens encrypted symmetrically (Fernet AES) and asynchronous backend architecture in FastAPI 0.110
📲 PWA & Liquid Design: Responsive Next.js 14 interface with glass-morphism effect, fully adapted for smartphone installation and offline use

smartQuoteAI.title: SmartQuote
smartQuoteAI.subtitle: - CRM & Sales Automation -
smartQuoteAI.description: A complete sales CRM for preparing quotes: it combines client management, a PDF block editor, sales workflow automation, and e-invoice integration. The application uses professional, ready-made document templates that AI automatically fills with content tailored to the client and scope of work.
highlights:
📋  Professional quote templates
AI automatically fills a ready-made document structure with content tailored to the client and scope of work

🤖  AI (Gemini 2.5 Flash)
Content generation for quotes, profitability analysis, post-mortem

📄  Dual PDF Engine
PDFKit (classic) + Puppeteer/Vercel (proposal)

✍️  E-signature with Audit
Canvas + SHA-256 hash, token-based public pages

🔗  KSeF Integration
HMAC-SHA256 webhook, idempotent send, NIP cache

shelltyKanban.title: Shellty.Kanban
shelltyKanban.subtitle: - Real-time Project Management -
shelltyKanban.description: A fullstack Kanban application for task management and team collaboration, built from scratch with .NET 10 and React 18. It includes board and card management with drag & drop, real-time collaboration via SignalR, and a complete Web Push system that works even when the app is closed.
shelltyKanban.highlightsTitle: WHAT MAKES THIS PROJECT STAND OUT:
highlights: 📡 Real-time with SignalR: live board updates, presence indicators, and "who is editing" status visible to all users without page refresh.
🔔 Web Push (VAPID + Service Worker): granular notification preferences per device and event type (create, update, move, delete, assign); system notifications work even when the app is closed.
🔒 JWT + Refresh Token: token rotation on every use, interceptor-based auto-refresh; secure per-device logout without disabling push notifications on other devices.
⚙️ CI/CD + Tests: GitHub Actions builds, tests, and deploys; 60+ xUnit tests with code coverage above 95%.

shelltyBlog.title: Shellty Blog
shelltyBlog.subtitle: - Modern MVC Blog Platform -
shelltyBlog.description: A modern CMS system built on ASP.NET Core MVC architecture with emphasis on design patterns and Clean Code. Fully containerized application integrated with a cloud PostgreSQL database (Neon).
highlights: Democratic Roles: Unique permission system requiring unanimous voting from all active administrators
MVC Architecture: Clean code structure based on file-scoped namespaces, nullable reference types, and zero compiler warnings
Image Handling: Advanced image upload module with server-side size and format validation and client-side preview
Dockerized: Full containerization ensuring stable deployment on Render using lightweight Linux x64 images

mobiSalon.title: Grooming Business Card with CMS
mobiSalon.subtitle: Website for a grooming salon.
mobiSalon.description: This is a light and clear one-page website designed with Next.js/React. The project combines an aesthetic presentation of a grooming salon with functionality that facilitates daily communication with customers. The site is fully responsive, which guarantees its impeccable operation and readability on smartphones and tablets.
mobiSalon.highlightsTitle: The heart of the site management is the News section, over which the owner has full control from the CMS panel (Decap CMS). They can instantly publish there:
highlights: Current announcements: important information about promotions, changes in the offer, or announcements for customers.
Availability calendar: an interactive summary where the administrator marks working days and free slots, informing customers about the salon's current schedule in real time.

pwaCookbook.title: Mobile Cookbook (PWA)
pwaCookbook.subtitle: Progressive Web Application - diploma project.
pwaCookbook.description: I developed a progressive web application (PWA) that helps in planning meals based on ingredients available in the kitchen. It integrates a recipe database, preparation instructions, and side dish cooking times, and a built-in timer with sound notification facilitates process control. The application was designed with a mobile-first approach and also works offline, remaining available on any device with a browser. As a result, it realy shortens the time spent on cooking and facilitates decision-making "what to cook". Project implemented based on React with an emphasis on performance and user convenience. It was created as part of a diploma thesis.

animalsOnePage.title: Interesting Animals - One Page
animalsOnePage.subtitle: Simple One Page website (student project).
animalsOnePage.description: A very simple, static one-page website prepared during studies as part of one of the tasks. It presents selected, interesting animal species in short sections with basic information and trivia. I treat it as a modest supplementary material showing consistency in documenting progress. I am aware that this is not a project representative of my current skills and I will soon replace it with newer, original projects.

ksefMaster.title: KSeF Master
ksefMaster.subtitle: - National E-Invoicing Ecosystem -
ksefMaster.description: Professional platform for integration with the government e-invoicing system (KSeF). .NET 8 and React 19 architecture providing full support for FA(2) documents, XML schema validation, and PDF visualizations.
highlights: API v2 Integration: Full communication with the Ministry of Finance gateway, online/offline session handling, and authorization via tokens and certificates
FA(2) Compliance: Generation of validatable XML documents and instant PDF visualizations with QR codes using the QuestPDF engine
Monorepo Workflow: Unified lifecycle of React 19 frontend and ASP.NET Core 8 backend in a single repository with automated CI/CD
Enterprise Architecture: Use of EF Core 8, FluentValidation, and JWT to ensure the highest data quality and transaction security

budmaxTheme.title: BudMax Theme
budmaxTheme.subtitle: Custom WordPress theme designed for the BudMax construction company. Minimalist design, performance, and full content control via ACF.
budmaxTheme.description: The project was created as a complete marketing solution - from PHP architecture through CSS/JS animations to AJAX forms with anti-spam protection. The theme does not use the block editor, which guarantees speed and code predictability.
highlights: Custom i18n system (PL/EN) based on cookies and query params - without WooCommerce Multilingual or WPML.
Speed Dial FAB with contact modal, honeypot, and rate-limiting.
Focal point (image cropping) controlled from the ACF panel via object-position.
SEO: hreflang, canonical, Open Graph - generated dynamically.
Deployment to Pantheon via Git with cache busting via filemtime().

tomiForno.title: Tomi Forno
tomiForno.subtitle: - Neapolitan Pizzeria · Full-Stack -
tomiForno.description: A multi-page full-stack pizzeria website built as a portfolio project. Features an interactive menu, gallery, reservation system, and a custom pizza builder. The builder includes an AI agent that suggests ingredient combinations, recommending which toppings pair well together.
tomiForno.highlightsTitle: WHAT MAKES THIS PROJECT STAND OUT:
highlights: 🍕 Pizza Builder: Interactive layer-by-layer composer (sauce/cheese/toppings) with live visual preview and hybrid pricing (dough + flat toppings)
🤖 AI Agent: Ingredient pairing suggestions based on flavour compatibility - the agent recommends which toppings work well together
🌍 i18n PL/EN: next-intl with [locale] routing, full bilingual support with language switcher in mobile navigation
📱 Mobile Nav: Pizza wheel as UX signature - hamburger opens a full-screen overlay with interactive navigator

notFound.desc: The page you are looking for does not exist or has been moved. Check the address or go back to the homepage.

sections.title: 1. Data controller
paragraphs: The controller of your personal data is Tomasz Skorupski (Shellty), the owner of this website.

sections.title: 2. What data I collect and why
paragraphs: I only collect the data you provide yourself:
items: Contact form: first name, email address and message - to answer your question.

The "Find your solution" qualifier and the assistant chat: first name, phone number or email address, your answers, optional additional information and the course of the conversation with the assistant - to prepare a proposal and contact you about your request.
With every request I also store the text and date of your consent, the page it was sent from and the site language.
after: The conversation with the assistant is also processed to generate replies (see section 6). Phone numbers and email addresses are not passed to AI services.

sections.title: 3. Legal basis
items: Requests from the qualifier and chat - your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR) and steps taken at your request before entering into a contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR).
Contact form - the legitimate interest of the controller, i.e. replying to your enquiry (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).
Protecting the site against spam and abuse - the legitimate interest of the controller (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).

sections.title: 4. How long I keep your data
items: Requests from the qualifier and chat - up to 12 months after sending, unless you ask for deletion or withdraw your consent earlier. If we start working together, data needed for the work is kept for as long as the law requires.
Contact form messages - for as long as needed to handle the enquiry.
Technical data protecting the site against abuse (an encrypted hash of the IP address that does not reveal the address itself, and request counters) - no longer than 12 months.
Your progress in the qualifier and the chat history are stored only in your browser session and disappear when you close the tab. They reach the server only when you send a request.

sections.title: 5. Recipients of data
paragraphs: I use providers who process data on my behalf:
items: Formspree, Inc. (USA) - contact form handling.
Cloudflare, Inc. (USA) - the server running the qualifier and chat, the request database and bot protection (Cloudflare Turnstile), which may analyse browser information and the IP address.
Groq, Inc. (USA) and Google LLC (USA, Gemini API) - generating the AI assistant replies from the conversation, after phone numbers and email addresses are removed.
after: These providers are based outside the European Economic Area. Data is transferred using mechanisms provided for in the GDPR, such as standard contractual clauses or the European Commission decision on the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework.
Apart from that, your data is not shared with anyone else. Providers' privacy policies:

sections.title: 6. AI assistant
items: The chat in the bottom right corner is an AI assistant, not Tomek. Replies are generated automatically by a language model (Groq or Google Gemini), so they may be incomplete or contain mistakes.
The assistant's replies are not an offer or a binding quote. Tomek agrees the scope and price personally after a conversation.
When AI services are unavailable, the chat replies with pre-written messages.
Do not enter sensitive data in the chat, e.g. health information, passwords or document numbers.
The "Find your solution" qualifier does not use AI - its questions and suggestions are written in advance.

sections.title: 7. Cookies and browser storage
items: The site does not use analytics or advertising cookies.
Browser storage keeps the selected site language and information needed for the qualifier and chat, e.g. whether the chat tip has already been shown.
Cloudflare Turnstile may store data in the browser needed to tell humans from bots.

sections.title: 8. Your rights
paragraphs: In connection with the processing of your personal data, you have the following rights:
items: Right of access - you can ask what data I hold about you.
Right to rectification - you can ask me to correct inaccurate data.
Right to erasure - you can ask me to delete your data (the right to be forgotten).
Right to restriction - you can ask me to suspend the processing of your data.
Right to object - you can object to processing based on legitimate interest.
Right to withdraw consent - at any time, without affecting the lawfulness of processing before withdrawal.

Right to lodge a complaint - if you believe I process your data unlawfully, you can complain to the President of the Personal Data Protection Office (UODO), ul. Stawki 2, 00-193 Warsaw, www.uodo.gov.pl.
sections.contact: To exercise these rights, contact me at:

launcher.label: Submit in a few steps
launcher.saved: Your answers are saved - you can come back any time.

qualifier.ownWords: I'd rather describe it in my own words

plan.title: Finding your solution
plan.readyHint: We'll settle the details in a call.

siteUrl.label: Your current website (optional) - I'll take a look and tell you what can be improved

website.label: A new website
website.reaction: Good call. Your website is where customers judge your business first - usually before they ever call.

app.label: An app for your business
app.reaction: Great. A well-fitted app can take hours of repetitive work off your plate every week.

fixes.label: Fixes and improvements
fixes.reaction: Understood. Often there's no need to rebuild everything - fixing and extending what you have is enough.

it.label: IT support
it.reaction: Good thinking. You only notice IT when it stops working, and then the whole business stops too.

unsure.label: Not sure - advise me
unsure.reaction: No problem, that's what I'm here for. The best solution usually comes from talking about goals, not technology.

emergency.label: Outage - I need help now
emergency.reaction: Understood, every minute of downtime costs. I'll skip the remaining questions.

goal.prompt: What do you want to achieve in the coming months?

more_clients.label: More customers from the internet
more_clients.reaction: More customers online usually comes down to two things: a website that convinces and being easy to find.

save_time.label: Saving time in my business
save_time.reaction: Time is the most valuable resource in a small business. Automating what you do by hand today usually wins a lot of it back.

broken.label: Something doesn't work
broken.reaction: Don't worry. I'll find the cause first and then propose the simplest lasting fix.

it_infra.label: Computers, network, server
it_infra.reaction: Computers, networks and servers are my area - I've worked with them professionally for years.

gastro.label: Food service, hotels, tourism
gastro.reaction: In food service it matters whether guests find the menu and book a table in seconds - ideally from their phone, without calling.

local.label: Local services, beauty, health
local.reaction: In local services people search Google for "near me" and choose whoever is easiest to book.

construction.label: Construction, crafts, manufacturing
construction.reaction: In construction customers buy with their eyes - photos of finished projects and reviews sell better than any description.

retail.label: Retail, shop
retail.reaction: In retail every extra step at checkout is a lost customer, so simplicity and mobile convenience matter most.

b2b.label: Office, business services (B2B)
b2b.reaction: Business clients expect substance and professionalism, and inside the company quotes and documents usually eat up the most time.

solo.label: Solo / just starting out
solo.reaction: At the start what counts is a strong first impression and a solution that grows with your business, without building things in advance.

other.label: Other industry
other.reaction: Every industry has its specifics - I'll ask about the details on the call, for now let's focus on your goal.

hasSite.prompt: Do you already have a website?

no.label: No, this is my first
no.reaction: Great, we're starting with a clean slate - I'll design everything around your customers from day one.

yes_new.label: Yes, but I want a new one
yes_new.reaction: Okay. Before I design a new one, I want to know what isn't working now, so we don't repeat the same mistakes.

yes_fix.label: Yes, I want to improve it
yes_fix.reaction: Then let's focus on what you already have - a few well-chosen changes often do more than a new website.

sitePains.prompt: What bothers you most about your current website?

no_clients.label: It doesn't bring customers
no_clients.reaction: That's the most common problem I see: the site looks fine but doesn't lead to contact. It can be fixed and measured.

outdated.label: It looks outdated
outdated.reaction: An outdated look costs credibility - customers subconsciously apply that impression to the whole business.

cant_edit.label: I can't change anything myself
cant_edit.reaction: A site you can't update yourself ages quickly. You'll get a simple panel for changes.

slow.label: It's slow
slow.reaction: A slow site loses customers before it loads, and Google notices too.

bad_mobile.label: It looks bad on phones
bad_mobile.reaction: Most visitors will reach you from a phone, so this is a priority.

siteGoals.prompt: What should the new website do for you above all?

more_leads.label: More enquiries from customers
more_leads.reaction: Okay, then I'll design it for enquiries: every section should lead customers to contact you.

google.label: Better visibility in Google
google.reaction: Visibility in Google starts with a fast site and well-structured content - I'll take care of that from the start.

self_edit.label: Editing content myself
self_edit.reaction: Understood. You'll get a simple panel to change texts and photos yourself.

booking.label: Online bookings or orders
booking.reaction: Online bookings work for you around the clock - customers book when it suits them, not when you can answer the phone.

ai.label: An AI assistant on the website
ai.reaction: Great direction. An AI assistant on your site can advise customers and answer their questions before they even write to you.

image.label: A professional image
image.reaction: First impressions are hard to change, so I'll make sure the look is consistent and professional from the first screen.

appPain.prompt: What takes up most of your or your team's time today?

excel.label: Retyping data and Excel spreadsheets
excel.reaction: Spreadsheets and retyping are a perfect candidate for improvement - data in one place means fewer mistakes and more time.

offers.label: Quotes, orders, customer service
offers.reaction: Quotes and customer service are the heart of sales. A faster, polished quote often decides who wins the deal.

invoices.label: Invoices and documents (e.g. KSeF)
invoices.reaction: KSeF matters to every Polish business today - I've already built it into my own e-invoicing system.

automation.label: Repetitive tasks that could be automated
automation.reaction: If you do something by the same pattern every time, it can almost certainly be automated.

ai.label: I want to add AI to my business
ai.reaction: Great direction. Well-implemented AI is not a gimmick: it advises customers, prepares content and takes load off the team.

mobile.label: I need a mobile app / PWA
mobile.reaction: A mobile app makes sense when you or your customers need access on the go, not just at a desk.

appStage.prompt: What stage is your idea at?

idea.label: I only have an idea
idea.reaction: That's a good moment - at the idea stage it's easiest to plan a solution that truly fits the business.

spec.label: I have a description or specification
spec.reaction: Great, a description speeds things up a lot. I'll review it and suggest what to simplify and what's worth adding.

existing.label: I have a system to extend
existing.reaction: Understood. I'll get to know the current system first, so the extension doesn't disturb what already works.

fixTarget.prompt: What does the website or app that needs fixing run on?

wordpress.label: A WordPress website
wordpress.reaction: I know WordPress inside out - I write my own themes, so I can handle unusual cases too.

other_cms.label: Another website or CMS
other_cms.reaction: Okay. I'll start with a quick review to find the simplest way to the goal.

webapp.label: A web application
webapp.reaction: Web applications are my everyday work, so I'll find my way around the code quickly.

unknown.label: I don't know what it runs on
unknown.reaction: No problem, I'll check it - I just need the website address.

fixTask.prompt: What exactly needs to be done?

broken.label: Something stopped working
broken.reaction: Understood. I'll find the cause first, so the fix lasts instead of being a quick patch.

feature.label: Add a new feature
feature.reaction: I'll add new features to what you already have, without rebuilding everything.

speed.label: Speed up the website
speed.reaction: Speed affects results: every second of loading means some customers give up.

finish.label: Finish an abandoned project
finish.reaction: Abandoned projects are common. I'll assess what can be reused and see the project through.

script.label: A script or automation
script.reaction: A script or automation is often the fastest way to win back a few hours a week.

itNeed.prompt: What kind of IT support do you need?

oneoff.label: One-off help or setup
oneoff.reaction: Okay. I'll do it properly and leave documentation, so it's clear what is set up and how.

ongoing.label: Ongoing IT care (external IT department)
ongoing.reaction: Ongoing care means peace of mind: I catch problems before they stop your business.

server.label: Server, hosting, business email
server.reaction: Server, hosting and email are the foundation - I'll set them up to run reliably and securely.

network.label: Network, devices, backups
network.reaction: A reliable network and backups are things you stop thinking about once they're done right.

outages.label: Frequent outages and downtime
outages.reaction: Every outage is lost time for the whole team - I'll start by finding the cause.

no_backup.label: No backups
no_backup.reaction: No backups is a risk worth removing as soon as possible - one disk failure can stop a business.

no_admin.label: Nobody looks after IT day to day
no_admin.reaction: Understood. IT handled "on the side" usually ends in firefighting. Ongoing care changes that.

slow.label: Slow network or hardware
slow.reaction: A slow network or hardware is a hidden cost the business pays every day in waiting.

security.label: Concerns about data security
security.reaction: Data security is also a GDPR requirement - I'll review it and point out specific gaps.

timeline.prompt: Last question: when do you want to start?

asap.label: As soon as possible
asap.reaction: Understood, it's urgent - I'll treat it as a priority.

month.label: Within a month
month.reaction: A month is a realistic timeframe to prepare and launch everything properly.

quarter.label: Within 1-3 months
quarter.reaction: Good, there's time to plan every stage calmly.

browsing.label: Just looking around
browsing.reaction: Sure, it's good to explore the options first - no obligation at all.
